segments.an5.21:1.1: “So vata, bhikkhave, bhikkhu agāravo appatisso asabhāgavuttiko ‘sabrahmacārīsu ābhisamācārikaṃ dhammaṃ paripūressatī’ti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.an5.21:1.2: ‘Ābhisamācārikaṃ dhammaṃ aparipūretvā sekhaṃ [sekkhaṃ (ka.)] dhammaṃ paripūressatī’ti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.an5.21:1.3: ‘Sekhaṃ dhammaṃ aparipūretvā sīlāni paripūressatī’ti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.an5.21:1.4: ‘Sīlāni aparipūretvā sammādiṭṭhiṃ paripūressatī’ti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.an5.21:1.5: ‘Sammādiṭṭhiṃ aparipūretvā sammāsamādhiṃ paripūressatī’ti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.an5.21:2.1: “So vata, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sagāravo sappatisso sabhāgavuttiko ‘sabrahmacārīsu ābhisamācārikaṃ dhammaṃ paripūressatī’ti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
segments.an5.21:2.2: ‘Ābhisamācārikaṃ dhammaṃ paripūretvā sekhaṃ dhammaṃ paripūressatī’ti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
segments.an5.21:2.3: ‘Sekhaṃ dhammaṃ paripūretvā sīlāni paripūressatī’ti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.

lines: Tatiyassa paṭhame asabhāgavuttikoti asabhāgāya visadisāya jīvitavuttiyā samannāgato.
